newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX oil prices seen opening flat to slightly off.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX oil prices seen opening flat to slightly off.

text.p: NYMEX oil prices were called steady to slightly lower Wednesday tracking ACCESS on no news.
Crude was called unchanged to five cents a barrel lower Heating oil and gasoline were called unchanged to 0.25 cent a gallon lower.
Dealers said crude would be rangebound until refined products could provide longer term direction.

"The market is pretty much unchanged. We are off our lows from yesterday, but the products wil have to do something to get us out of this range," said a New York trader. March crude has been in a range of $21.50 to $22.50 for about a week.
